reports_net_worth_copy: Asset and liability value at each selected calendar bucket end.
reports_filter_accounts_empty: No accounts to filter by yet.
reports_filter_commodities_empty: No commodities to filter by yet.
reports_filter_categories_empty: No categories to filter by yet.
reports_filter_payees_empty: No payees to filter by yet.
reports_filter_include_descendants: Include sub-accounts of the selected accounts
reports_filter_options_error: Those options could not be loaded.
reports_loading_copy: Reading exact balances from the posted ledger.
reports_error_copy: Refresh the report and try again.
reports_empty_copy: Post transactions in the selected period to see net worth over time.
reports_chart_negative_note: Columns below the line are negative; they are also hatched, so the direction does not depend on colour.
reports_net_worth_chart_caption: Net worth at each period end, in {commodity}, summarizing the table above.
reports_cashflow_chart_caption: Net movement per period, in {commodity}, summarizing the table above.
reports_multi_commodity_notice: Totals are shown separately by commodity. Choose a reporting currency to add a restated line in one unit.
reports_unclassified_short_notice: Some periods contain a negative coin or share position that has not been identified as a short sale. Review the dated account register. These net worth figures include that position; converted totals and charts are withheld until it is corrected or classified.
reports_unsettled_notice: Some periods include trades or dividends whose cash had not moved yet. Net worth counts a trade's cash on the trade date and a dividend on its ex-dividend date; the account balance changes when the cash moves.
reports_converted_row_note: Restated rows are additional, never a replacement: each figure is converted at the rate for its own date, while the exact totals above stay untouched.
reports_converted_total: Total across every group, restated in {commodity}: {amount}
reports_valuation_stale: Some rates came from an earlier day than the one asked for: {dates}.
reports_valuation_incomplete: No rate was found for {commodities}, so the figures that would have included them are left out rather than shown short. The exact totals are unaffected.
reports_cashflow_copy: Money in and out of your liquid accounts, with transfers kept separate from spending.
reports_cashflow_scope_default: Measuring your {count} active cash accounts — cash, checking, savings, and brokerage cash.
reports_cashflow_transfer_policy: Moving money to an account outside this set — paying a card, funding a brokerage — is shown as a transfer, never as spending.
reports_cashflow_identity_note: Net movement is operating net plus transfers, and matches the change in these accounts' balances over each period.
reports_cashflow_drill_down_hint: Select an in or out figure to see which categories it was made of, over the same period and accounts.
reports_cashflow_loading_copy: Reading posted movements for the selected range.
reports_cashflow_error_copy: The report did not load. Check the range and try again.
reports_cashflow_empty_title: No cash moved in this range
reports_cashflow_empty_copy: Post transactions against a cash account, or widen the date range.
reports_spending_copy: Expense totals over the selected range, ranked within each commodity.
reports_income_copy: Income totals over the selected range, ranked within each commodity.
reports_spending_loading_copy: Reading exact category postings from the posted ledger.
reports_spending_error_copy: Refresh the report and try again.
reports_spending_empty_copy: Transfers between your own accounts are never counted here. Post transactions with a category in the selected range to see totals.
reports_spending_multi_commodity_notice: Rows are ordered by {commodity}; groups measured in another commodity follow. Totals and shares stay separate per commodity and are never combined. The chart appears when a single commodity is in range, or when a reporting currency restates every group.
reports_spending_multi_commodity_notice_: Totals and shares stay separate per commodity and are never combined. The chart appears when a single commodity is in range.
reports_spending_chart_caption: Totals in {commodity}, summarizing the table above.
reports_spending_negative_note: Hatched bars net negative for the period, because refunds exceeded spending.
reports_spending_grouping_policy: Rows are the categories postings landed on; a parent category does not include its children.
import_upload_copy: Choose a QIF file or a bank CSV statement. CSV mappings can be saved and reused for the next statement.
import_upload_encoding_help: If names look wrong or detection is uncertain, choose the encoding used by the source application.
import_csv_analysis_error: The CSV header could not be decoded. Select the source file’s text encoding and try again.
import_upload_ms_money_help: How to export from MS Money
import_upload_ms_money_steps: In MS Money: open the account → File → Export → choose Loose QIF → save and upload here.
import_preview_copy: Review the transactions below. Assign an account, currency, and default category to each import, then click Commit.
import_preview_unsupported_fill: Unsupported or missing fill type — review required; import will skip it
import_preview_source_changed: Source fill changed — review required; import will skip it
import_preview_correct_buy_scope: Applies the provider's revised quantity and net amount. Date, instrument, account, and currency changes need another correction workflow.
import_preview_parse_error: Not readable under this file's format — fix the profile or file and upload again, or exclude the row; it will not be imported
import_warning_unrecognized_date: Date “{value}” does not match the file's date layout; this row will not be imported
import_warning_unrecognized_amount: Amount “{value}” does not match the file's decimal separator; this row will not be imported
import_warning_unrecognized_split_amount: Split amount “{value}” does not match the file's decimal separator; this row will not be imported
import_warning_decimal_separator_conflic: Amounts in this file disagree on their decimal separator; the file was read with “{value}”. Set a decimal separator on the import profile if that is wrong.
import_warning_decimal_separator_undecid: Amounts in this file disagree on their decimal separator too evenly to settle it; each amount was read on its own. Set a decimal separator on the import profile to be sure.
import_warning_date_layout_conflict: Dates in this file disagree on their layout; they were read as {value}. Set a date layout on the import profile if that is wrong.
import_warning_date_layout_ambiguous: Every date in this file is ambiguous (no day above 12); they were read as {value}. Set a date layout on the import profile if that is wrong.
import_preview_no_rows: No transactions found in the file.
import_payees_copy: Choose an existing payee or create a new record. The choice applies to every matching row in this import.
import_payees_error_copy: Retry before resolving the names in this import.
import_commit_reconciliation_override_hi: Allow imported rows to land inside already-reconciled periods. Use with care.
import_commit_checkpoints_title: This commit will invalidate these reconciliation checkpoints:
import_commit_checkpoints_none: No pending row reaches a reconciled period.
import_commit_checkpoints_changed: The checkpoints this commit reaches changed. Review the list and commit again.
import_result_failed: {count} failed — review the remaining rows to fix them
import_discard_confirm: Discard this import batch? The staged rows will be removed.
import_error_no_adapter: This file format is not supported. Please upload a QIF or CSV file.
import_csv_mapping_copy: Choose an existing bank profile or map this statement's headers once and save the mapping.
import_csv_header_error: The CSV header could not be read. Check that the first row has unique column names.
import_csv_profiles_error: Saved mappings could not be loaded. Try again before importing this CSV.
import_csv_profile_delete_confirm: Delete this reusable mapping? Previous imports remain in history.
reconcile_start_copy: Pick an account, then enter the closing date and balance from your statement.
reconcile_start_no_accounts: No reconcilable accounts. Create a cash or liability account first.
reconcile_start_no_commodity: This account has no default currency. Set one on the account before reconciling it.
reconcile_start_balance_help: The closing balance shown on the statement, including a minus sign for a negative balance.
reconcile_start_invalid_balance: Enter a valid amount, for example 1234.56.
reconcile_session_copy: Tick each posting that appears on the statement. The difference updates as you go.
reconcile_session_empty_copy: There are no postings in this account for the statement period.
reconcile_session_error_copy: Something went wrong loading this reconciliation session.
reconcile_finish_hint: Finishing is available once the difference is zero.
reconcile_finished_copy: This account is reconciled through the statement date. A checkpoint was recorded.
reconcile_checkpoints_empty: This account has not been reconciled yet.
reconcile_checkpoints_history_copy: These statements no longer anchor the balance. Their postings are offered again, preselected, in the next reconciliation.
reconcile_checkpoints_error: Reconciled statements could not be loaded.
reconcile_checkpoint_void_copy: The statement of {date} with an ending balance of {balance} will stop anchoring this account. It stays listed under “No longer current”.
reconcile_checkpoint_void_offered_copy: Its postings will be offered again, preselected, in the next reconciliation.
reconcile_checkpoint_void_chained_copy: A later statement was reconciled on top of this one, so its postings stay covered until that later statement is voided too.
reconcile_checkpoint_void_needs_reason: Enter a reason to void this statement.
import_connections_copy: Connect an online provider to import transactions automatically.
import_connections_empty: No online connections. Add one below to import from Trading 212 or another provider.
import_connections_cash_account_error: Could not set the cash account.
import_connections_add_cash_account_help: Where BUY/SELL/DIVIDEND cash lands. Can be set or changed later.
import_connections_delete_confirm: Delete this connection? This does not affect already-imported transactions.
import_connections_auto_refresh_on: Auto-refresh is on. This connection fetches new activity automatically about once a day.
import_connections_auto_refresh_off: Auto-refresh is off. Use Refresh to fetch new activity manually.
import_connections_add_key_help: Generate an API key in the Trading 212 app under Settings → API.
import_connections_error_provider: The API key was rejected by Trading 212. Check the key and try again.
import_connections_error_config: The server is not configured for online connections. Set REKENRAAM_SECRET_KEY.
import_connections_error_duplicate: A connection with this name already exists.
import_connections_refetch_help: Refresh checks recent activity. Re-fetch full history checks for older changes and missing fills. Existing transactions are not imported twice; changed trades need review. Large histories may take longer.
import_connections_fetch_error: Could not start the fetch. Check the connection and try again.
import_fetching_copy: This can take a moment. You can leave this page; the fetch keeps running in the background.
import_fetching_failed_copy: Check the connection's API key and try again.
settings_card_language_copy: Choose the language the interface is shown in.
language_copy: The interface language is stored in this browser. Amounts, dates, and numbers follow the language you pick.
language_translation_progress_copy: These translations are drafted from a terminology glossary and have not yet been reviewed by a native speaker. Anything not yet translated is shown in English rather than left blank.
import_rules_copy: Apply the first matching rule when a new file is staged. You can review every result before committing.
import_rules_action_required: Choose at least one category, payee, or tag action.
recurring_incomplete: Add a balanced entry with at least two postings.
recurring_schedule_help: Dates use your time zone. Short months use their last day. Past dates are not backfilled when creating or rescheduling.
recurring_impact_changed: Reconciliation impacts changed. Cancel and review the remaining drafts again.
recurring_discarded: Draft discarded. This occurrence will not regenerate.
recurring_archived: Template archived. Existing drafts remain available.
recurring_due_help: Generated entries stay in draft until you post them. Review amounts, edit or discard each draft; blocked occurrences need attention.
recurring_retry_help: Try refreshing. Your saved entries are unchanged.
recurring_due_empty_copy: Create a template or check back when an entry is due.
recurring_blocked_help: No draft was created. Fix the template or referenced account, then retry; or skip this occurrence.
recurring_still_blocked: Occurrence is still blocked. Check its diagnostic details.
recurring_template_help: Templates create drafts only. Posting is always your decision.
recurring_occurrences_help: Dates from today through the next year. Generated and skipped dates remain recorded.
recurring_post_help: Confirm these drafts to include them in your ledger balances and reports. Selected drafts are posted individually; completed postings remain if a later draft fails.
recurring_discard_help: This removes the draft and records a permanent skip. The scheduler will not recreate this occurrence.
recurring_archive_help: Stop future generation from this template. Existing drafts and occurrence history remain available.
forecast_horizon_error: Enter a whole number from 1 to 366.
forecast_accounts_default: No selection uses active cash accounts.
forecast_reporting_help: Optional. Uses one stored exchange rate from the as-of date for the whole forecast.
forecast_loading_copy: Reading recorded entries and recurring assumptions without changing them.
forecast_error_copy: Check the filters or refresh the forecast.
forecast_invalid_filters_copy: Reset the filters to return to the default 90-day cash forecast.
forecast_no_accounts_title: No eligible accounts in this scope
forecast_no_accounts_copy: Choose another scope or create an active cash account. No balances were silently substituted.
forecast_assumptions_notice: Carried forward: {carried}. Excluded: {excluded}. Saved dates and transactions were not changed.
forecast_diagnostic_carried: Overdue or today’s recurring entry moved to tomorrow
forecast_fx_complete: Complete coverage using rates selected at {date}. Stored rates used: {count}.
forecast_fx_incomplete: A complete combined balance cannot be shown. Exact currency balances remain available.
forecast_fx_gap: {commodity}: no usable rate; nearest earlier observation: {date}
forecast_fx_policy: Rates stay fixed for every future day. Openings and each daily source component are rounded separately, half away from zero.
forecast_no_movement_title: No scheduled changes in this range
forecast_no_movement_copy: The daily balances stay flat, but recorded opening balances are still shown.
forecast_liability_note: A negative liability balance means money owed; it is not a cash shortfall alert.
forecast_daily_copy: The table is authoritative; the chart summarizes the same exact balances.
forecast_chart_accessible_label: Two-line chart comparing recorded-only and projected balances. Exact values are in the table.
forecast_event_empty: No included event affects this day and selected series.
forecast_event_basis_changed: The underlying records changed. Balances were refreshed; reopen a day to inspect current details.
forecast_learning_intro: Learn ordinary variable spending from your own history, such as groceries or travel. Estimates are shown separately from recorded entries and recurring bills, and nothing is ever saved to your ledger.
forecast_learning_estimate_notice: These figures are estimates, not saved bills. Turning them off restores the recorded and recurring views unchanged.
forecast_learning_history_help: The date from which the selected accounts are completely recorded. An opening balance or oldest transaction does not establish coverage.
forecast_learning_categories_help: No selection uses every eligible category. At most 20.
forecast_learning_status_ready: Every selected category could be estimated. This is not a claim about future accuracy.
forecast_learning_status_partial: {eligible} of {requested} categories could be estimated. The rest are listed below with a reason.
forecast_learning_status_unavailable: No category could be estimated, so no estimated curve is shown.
forecast_learning_reason_insufficient_hi: Not enough confirmed history yet: 16 complete weeks or months are required.
forecast_learning_reason_insufficient_se: An annual seasonal pattern needs 36 consecutive complete months, so that each month has been seen more than once and a full year can be held back for testing.
forecast_learning_reason_sparse_history: Too few periods with any spending to fit a pattern.
forecast_learning_reason_recurring_overl: A recurring template or draft already covers this category, so estimating it again would count the same money twice.
forecast_learning_reason_ambiguous_known: Spending already recorded for this period could not be identified exactly, so no estimate was added.
forecast_learning_reason_resource_limit: Too much data to fit within the configured limits.
forecast_learning_reason_busy: Another estimate is being calculated. Try again shortly.
forecast_learning_reason_calendar_limit: The requested dates fall outside the supported calendar.
forecast_learning_reason_computation_tim: Calculating the estimate took too long and was stopped.
forecast_learning_warning_uniform_timing: No usable day-of-period pattern was observed, so the estimate is spread evenly.
forecast_learning_warning_seasonality_no: This seasonal profile was not more accurate than a flat average. It is kept as you selected it, but treat it as weak evidence.
forecast_learning_warning_sparse_annual_: At least one month's peak rests on a single observation.
forecast_learning_fallback_no_validated_: A plain baseline was used: the learned model was not measurably better.
forecast_learning_fallback_perfect_basel: A plain baseline was used: it already matched the history exactly.
forecast_learning_training_window: Trained on {count} complete {unit}, {start} to {end}, of which {positive} had spending.
forecast_learning_tested_horizon: Tested over {count} {unit} ({start} to {end}). Longer projections continue the same assumptions and were not tested.
forecast_learning_variation: Observed between {minimum} and {maximum}. This is historical variation, not a range the future is expected to fall in.
import_preview_correct_buy_impact: This correction affects these reconciliation checkpoints:
import_preview_correct_sale_scope: Applies the provider's revised quantity and positive net amount, keeping the recorded basis method. Date, instrument, account, and currency changes need another correction workflow. Quantity changes for explicitly selected lots need a manual correction.
import_result_gain_review: {count} imported purchases would change gains on earlier sales and were not committed yet.
import_result_reconciliation_held: {count} rows would change a reconciled period and are waiting for your confirmation.
import_result_reconciliation_stale: {count} rows would now invalidate a checkpoint you did not review. Nothing was changed; review and commit them again.
import_preview_row_reconciliation_held: Waiting: changes a reconciled period — confirm below to import
import_preview_row_failed: Not imported — fix the row and commit again
import_preview_split_link_scope: Trading 212 does not report a split ratio, so this row never posts. Record the split on the Investments screen, then link this row to it so a later fetch cannot post it again.
import_preview_split_link_empty: No split of this security has been recorded yet.
import_preview_split_link_already: Already linked to another import row
import_preview_short_link_scope: This fill type is not a documented trade, so the row never posts and is never treated as a short on its own. If you recorded this short sale or cover yourself, link the row to it so a later fetch cannot post it again. Every known date, unit, cash and account fact must match.
import_preview_short_link_empty_sale: No short sale of this security has been recorded yet.
import_preview_short_link_empty_cover: No short cover of this security has been recorded yet.
import_preview_short_link_record: Record it on the Investments screen
import_preview_short_link_already: Already linked to another import row
import_investment_mapping_help: The amount columns are signed cash movement. Map gross dividends separately; gross minus withholding must equal cash. Instruments match exact existing commodity codes, not guessed symbols.
import_investment_review_help: Confirm each instrument and account. Gross minus tax must match signed cash exactly. Separate tax pays cash out and creates no gross income.
import_investment_cash_invalid: The cash amount could not be read. Correct the file or number mapping and upload again.
import_investment_empty: Create the required instruments in Investments before committing.
import_dividend_help: Confirm gross, withholding and accounts. You can leave a payment for later; other rows can still be imported.
import_dividend_source_resolution: Use source identity; otherwise leave unassigned
import_dividend_declare_no_tax: Declare source cash as gross with no withholding
import_dividend_repaired: Dividend attribution repaired; cash payment preserved.
income_coverage_help: Owner-confirmed dividend income by paying instrument, beside investment cash that is not yet attributed. Unknown gross or withholding is shown as unknown, never as zero. Resolving it is optional.
income_coverage_error: Income coverage could not be loaded.
income_coverage_empty: No dividend income or unassigned investment cash is recorded.
income_coverage_attributed_empty: No dividend is attributed to an instrument yet.
income_coverage_gross_unresolved: Unknown — only the cash received is known
income_coverage_withholding_unresolved: Unknown — not assumed to be zero
income_coverage_instrument_pending: {count} imported payments naming this instrument ({cash} cash) are not classified and are excluded from these figures.
income_coverage_unassigned_empty: All identified dividend cash is attributed.
income_coverage_unassigned_help: Exact cash received, by original currency. It is not gross income and is not included in any instrument above.
income_coverage_total_counts: {count} payments: {payer} without a payer, {economics} with unknown gross and withholding
income_coverage_repair_named: Open payment to correct its payer
income_coverage_optional: You can leave any of these unresolved. Known cash stays in your balances and reports.
income_coverage_instrument_none: No recorded dividend income for this instrument.
income_coverage_instrument_excluded: Not included: {count} unassigned payments in the book ({amounts}) whose payer or gross and tax are unresolved.
returns_help: Time-weighted and money-weighted returns of your investment accounts over a period, in one reporting currency. Read-only: nothing is posted or moved.
returns_error_copy: Nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps failing, the message below says why.
returns_no_currency_copy: Returns are calculated in one reporting currency. Add an active currency first.
returns_range_invalid: Choose a start on or before the end, and an end no later than today.
returns_accounts_help: Leave all unticked to use every investment account. A ticked account includes its sub-accounts. Money moving between ticked accounts is not a contribution or withdrawal.
returns_accounts_none: There are no asset or liability accounts yet.
returns_empty_copy: Returns need at least one brokerage, brokerage cash, holding or crypto wallet account, or a ticked account above.
returns_twr_help: How the investments performed, independent of when you added or took out money (daily-linked TTWROR).
returns_mwr_help: What your own money earned, including the timing of your contributions and withdrawals (IRR).
returns_coverage_incomplete: No usable price or exchange rate for: {commodities}. Figures that need it are not shown.
returns_coverage_stale: Some prices or rates come from earlier days: {dates}.
returns_fallbacks_help: These payments could not be tied to one holding, so they were counted by where the cash landed. Nothing was posted to make them fit; assigning the instrument resolves them.
returns_fallback_held_inside_and_outside: instrument held inside and outside the portfolio
returns_fallback_not_held: instrument not held on the entitlement date
returns_scope_default: Every investment account, with its sub-accounts.
returns_scope_selected: The accounts you ticked, with their sub-accounts.
returns_read_only: Calculated from the ledger as known at {cutoff} (policy returns_v1). A later correction can restate this period.
returns_reason_valuation: Needs a price or exchange rate that is missing.
returns_reason_valuation_dated: Needs a price or exchange rate for {date} that is missing.
returns_reason_unclassified_short: A negative holding is not recorded as a short sale.
returns_reason_unclassified_short_dated: On {date} a negative holding is not recorded as a short sale.
returns_reason_flow: A contribution or withdrawal could not be converted to the reporting currency.
returns_reason_non_positive_capital: The portfolio had no positive value to measure a return on.
returns_reason_non_positive_capital_date: On {date} the portfolio had no positive value to measure a return on.
returns_reason_no_capital: Nothing was invested in this period.
returns_reason_no_root: The money in and out has no rate that balances it.
returns_reason_root_not_unique: Money went in and out more than once, so more than one rate could fit; none is chosen. The time-weighted return still applies.
returns_reason_numerical_limit: The rate is too extreme to calculate reliably.
returns_reason_period_shorter_than_year: Shown only for periods of at least a year.
returns_reason_non_positive_growth: A loss of 100 % or more cannot be expressed per year.
returns_accounts_unavailable: These selected accounts are not portfolio accounts in this book and will be left out:
returns_updating: Updating with the latest ledger and prices…
returns_run_frozen: Saved from the ledger as known at {cutoff} (policy returns_v1). Later corrections do not change these figures.
returns_runs_note: A saved run keeps its figures after corrections or price withdrawals. Open one to compare it with today's figures or download it.
returns_runs_save_note: The server recalculates the applied period, accounts, currency and benchmark from one snapshot of the book and saves the result. Nothing is posted.
returns_runs_save_unavailable: Apply a selection with at least one account and wait for its figures to save a run.
returns_runs_saved: Run saved. It is open below.
returns_runs_open_error: Could not open this saved run.
returns_runs_frozen_note: These figures are frozen at the saved time. Account, currency and instrument names are shown as they are today.
returns_chart_help: Cumulative from the start of the period to the end of each day shown. Where a point has no value the line is broken, never filled in.
returns_chart_interval_week: One point every 7 days, and the last day.
returns_chart_interval_month: One point per month end, and the last day.
returns_chart_accessible_label: Line chart of the cumulative time-weighted return from {from} to {to}. The table of points below lists every value.
returns_chart_empty: No point has a value, so there is no line to draw. The table of points says why.
returns_chart_coverage: Points without a usable price or exchange rate for: {commodities}. The figures above do not need them.
returns_chart_coverage_stale: Some points use prices or rates from earlier days: {dates}.
returns_benchmark_help: Compare with one instrument's price series, read as one unit held through the period and converted into the reporting currency. Manual prices count.
returns_benchmark_basis_total: Total return (only prices recorded as total return)
returns_benchmark_instruments_error: Instruments could not be loaded, so no benchmark is shown.
returns_benchmark_unavailable: Benchmark {benchmark} is not an instrument in this book and was left out.
returns_benchmark_card_help: Time-weighted return over the same period. A benchmark has no contributions or withdrawals, so this is the change in its value.
returns_benchmark_coverage: {name} has no usable price on some days; those benchmark figures are left out.
returns_benchmark_coverage_total: {name} has no usable total-return price on some days. A total-return benchmark uses only prices recorded with the total-return basis; raw prices never stand in.
returns_chart_benchmark_gaps: The benchmark has no value at {missing} of {total} points; its line breaks there.
returns_reason_conflicting_splits: Holdings record different split ratios for the benchmark on one day.
returns_reason_conflicting_splits_dated: Holdings record different split ratios for the benchmark on {date}.
returns_reason_short_position: Not calculated for a short position: an instrument holds no cash to carry the short's capital.
returns_reason_income_unattributable: Income for an instrument also held outside the selected accounts cannot be attributed.
returns_reason_income_unattributable_dat: Income on {date} for an instrument also held outside the selected accounts cannot be attributed.
returns_reason_unclassified_exchange: A journal entry exchanges two instruments without saying what was exchanged for what.
returns_reason_unclassified_exchange_dat: A journal entry on {date} exchanges two instruments without saying what was exchanged for what.
returns_reason_instrument_gain_unavailab: Unavailable while the portfolio gain or an instrument's gain is unavailable.
returns_instruments_toggle_help: Adds each instrument's own return, including its income. Saved runs keep this choice.
returns_instruments_help: Each instrument covers only its units in the selected accounts, never cash. Instrument returns are not weighted into the portfolio return.
returns_instruments_income_rule: Income counts on its ex date when one is recorded, otherwise on its entry date.
returns_instruments_coverage: Missing prices or rates for this instrument: {commodities}.
returns_instruments_residual_help: Portfolio gain less every instrument's gain: cash interest, FX on cash, fees not linked to a trade, unattributed income and ex-date timing. A difference, not a breakdown.
returns_instruments_not_attributed_title: Income not attributed to an instrument ({count})
returns_instruments_not_attributed_help: Recognised in this period but carried by no instrument. Where the portfolio could not tie a payment to a holding either, the entry says whether the portfolio figures count it.
returns_benchmark_coverage_fx: {name} has prices in {currency}, but {currency} has no usable exchange rate on some days; those benchmark figures are left out.
returns_allocation_help: Shares of the portfolio's value on the last day of the period. Long and short positions are shown separately, never netted.
returns_allocation_known_only: Some holdings have no usable price on this day, so shares are of the priced value only.
returns_allocation_unknown_title: Without a usable price on this day
returns_allocation_non_positive: The portfolio's value is zero or negative, so shares cannot be shown.
returns_allocation_non_positive_known_on: The priced holdings are worth zero or less, so shares cannot be shown. The portfolio's total value is unknown.
returns_allocation_empty: Nothing was held at the end of this day.
search_empty: No results. Try another name or scope.
search_partial_error: Some objects could not be loaded. Page links and commands are still available.
search_navigation_error: Could not open this result. Try again.
attention_clear: All clear for the available checks.
attention_source_error: Could not check this source. Retry to get current counts.
attention_source_running: Work is running; the result is not yet known.
keyboard_help_escape: Close a dialog, menu or panel
keyboard_help_note: Shortcuts never act while you type in a field.
briefing_needs_price_named: Net worth needs a price for {code}
